purpose: The figures in assets/charts/*.svg are outlined to paths and cannot be read or edited by a model. This file holds them as data, with sources, so a chart can be rebuilt live with real figures instead of retyped by hand.

status_key.verified: Figure checked against a public statement by the cited source and found to match.
status_key.transcribed: Read from the chart artwork. The source is cited on the chart but the figure has not been independently checked. Usable, but verify before publishing a new claim built on it.
status_key.not-quotable: The chart plots positions without printing values. Do not quote numbers read off the geometry; they are estimates, not data.
